outcome_text: We will distribute 1,200 winter coats to students at our partner schools this winter.
Each participating student will receive a backpack filled with grade-level school supplies.
The league will provide cleats, shin guards and a uniform to every player at no cost.
Every student we serve will have a warm winter coat and properly fitting shoes by December.
Fewer students in our partner schools will go without the school supplies they need.
Girls in the program will report having enough period products during their last period.
Every participating student will have a working laptop and home internet.
Participating families will have their basic needs met.
Reduce material hardship among the children we serve.
Students will have the soap, deodorant and toothpaste they need each week.
Children in our program will no longer go without clothes and shoes that fit.
Students will start the school year with every item on their supply list.
Students who receive uniforms and shoes from our clothing closet will miss fewer days of school.
Free period products will mean no student misses school because of her period.
With donated equipment, more girls will join the soccer team and stay on it all season.
Youth who get gear from our equipment drive will sign up for a sport this year.
Kids who receive a bicycle will be more physically active after school.
Girls will take part fully in class during their period.
Students who receive new clothes will feel more confident in themselves.
Students will feel they fit in at school and are not singled out because of their clothing.
Families will spend less of their budget on back-to-school clothing and supplies.
Every player on our teams will have the gear they need to play this season.
Students will have the supplies they need to be ready to learn.
Students will have properly fitting shoes and will attend school more regularly.
Children will feel dignity wearing clothes that fit them.
